name: zk
description: Shared zettelkasten backed by SQLite, FTS5, and sqlite-vec. Creates, updates, links, semantically searches, and recalls related notes. The database is multi-agent safe via SQLite WAL and short transactions.

action.description: Operation to perform. Defaults to search_hybrid.

db.description: Optional database path. Defaults to STRAP_ZK_DB or the Nushell config directory.

id.description: Note id for get, update, related, or targeted reindex.

title.description: Note title for create or update.

body.description: Markdown note body for create or update.

type.description: Link type, such as related, cites, refines, contradicts, parent, or same-as.

dimensions.description: Embedding dimensions when initializing a database.
